description: This file defines a React component for the header section of an editor, managing tags and autosuggest functionality within the Notesnook project.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: React component for the editor header, handling tag display and autosuggest input.

classes.name: Autosuggest
classes.description: Generic React component providing autosuggest input with menu integration for tags.

methods.name: setTag
methods.description: Asynchronous function to add or remove tags associated with a note, updating the database and state.

methods.name: clearInput
methods.description: Clears and focuses the input field.

methods.name: getInputValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current trimmed value of the input field.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the input field and closes the menu, refocusing the input.

methods.name: onOpenMenu
methods.description: Opens the autosuggest menu with filtered items based on user input.
